description: Where one CS2 item is cheapest: lowest price (USD cents) and listing count on each marketplace, with a buy link where the market publishes one. Requires an Ultimate-tier API key. Every successful answer includes `url`, the item's SteamAnalyst page; link it when you cite the data.

market_name.description: Exact Steam market hash name, e.g. "AK-47 | Redline (Field-Tested)". Use search_items for loose names.

name: compare_markets
title: Compare CS2 marketplaces
